deficits.suggestion: Construct a proper sidewalk on the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Remove obstructions from the left-side footway to ensure it is fully usable.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing to improve safety at this busy junction.

ratings.reason: The right side shows a dirt/informal path with parked scooters instead of a proper footway.
The left footway is partially obstructed by signage and street furniture.
There is high pedestrian demand but no marked crossing visible in the immediate foreground/midground.
